# Provenance

Vendored from https://github.com/dmmulroy/anti-slop at commit
c44ef22ca116d0ba62a3ff663a0bd13a3f3fa40b (MIT). Test files were removed.

The spacing engine under `vendor/` comes from ESLint Stylistic (MIT); see the
license and provenance files in that directory.

anti-slop is meant to be vendored and owned by the project that uses it. Edit
these rules freely. To pull upstream changes, run
`npx skills add dmmulroy/anti-slop --skill install-anti-slop` and ask your agent
to update anti-slop while preserving local customizations.
